entries.source: The rift leads to another floor of the dungeon.
entries.target: 这道裂隙通往地城的另一层。
装满金属般液体的小瓶
装满黏糊糊液体的小瓶

entries.source: This is a large dog, bred and trained for fighting.
entries.target: 这是一条大型犬，被培育和训练用于战斗。

entries.source: This is a large dog, bred and trained for fighting. Something about the way it moves doesn't look normal.
entries.target: 这是一条大型犬，被培育和训练用于战斗。不过，它运动起来的方式似乎有些不太正常。

entries.source: A shadow, almost humanoid in shape. Long claws extend in front of it as is swims through the air.
entries.target: 一个影子，看起来几乎是人类的形状。它在空气中游动，长长的利爪伸在身前。

entries.source: A shadow, almost humanoid in shape. It seems to move carefully and with cunning before swiftly striking.
entries.target: 一个影子，看起来几乎是人类的形状。它谨慎而狡猾地移动，然后迅猛出击。

entries.source: A shadow, almost humanoid in shape. At times its form seems to be a force of will rather than something real.
entries.target: 一个影子，看起来几乎是人类的形状。有时它的形态看上去不像是某种真实存在的物体，而是某种意志的力量。

entries.source: This elf is a companion of Berethh. He's dressed in light armor and wields a sword.
entries.target: 这个精灵战士是贝里斯的同伴。他身穿皮甲，手拿长剑。

entries.source: This elf is a companion of Berethh. He's dressed in light armor and wields a bow.
entries.target: 这个精灵弓手是贝里斯的同伴。他身穿皮甲，手拿长弓。

entries.source: This is Kyless, your old friend. He seems dirtier than you recall and a good bit more dangerous.
entries.target: 这是凯勒斯，你的老朋友。他比你的记忆中更加蓬头垢面，也更加危险。

entries.source: and fed to his corrupted dogs
entries.target: 并将其喂给了他堕落的恶犬

entries.source: This is Berethh, your old friend. He is dressed in well-worn leather and skillfully wields a bow. There is something noble about the way he carries himself but his expression carries no emotion.
entries.target: 这是贝里斯，你的老朋友。他穿着磨损的皮甲，熟练地使用着长弓。他举止高贵，但脸上毫无表情。

entries.source: and quickly burned in a pyre
entries.target: 并迅速将其放在火葬柴堆上烧掉
